content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often exclude creators in regions like Kenya, leaving you without viable options to sell digital products. COREMERCH's infrastructure circumvents these limitations by utilizing blockchain technology, which allows you to accept payments in cryptocurrencies directly. This approach ensures that you have full control over your transactions, eliminating dependence on platforms that may not serve your needs. The decentralized nature of blockchain also means faster settlement times, with cryptocurrencies like USDT on Tron settling in under 60 seconds for minimal fees.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your digital commerce stack, gather the necessary tools and resources. You will need a domain, access to a hosting service like Cloudflare Pages, and a payment processor that supports cryptocurrency, such as NOWPayments. Familiarize yourself with GitHub for version control and deployment. Additionally, create your digital products—ebooks, templates, or courses—and ensure they are ready for distribution. Having a clear understanding of your target audience and marketing strategy will also help you effectively launch your offerings.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Establishing a payment and delivery pipeline is crucial for your ebook sales. Start by integrating NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency transactions, which will allow you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a low fee of 0.5%. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage and delivery, ensuring that your customers receive their purchases automatically. Set up a backend solution using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle order processing and delivery notifications. This infrastructure allows you to run your operations efficiently without relying on conventional payment platforms.
Blockchain technology provides unprecedented control over your transactions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place, it’s time to go live. Publish your website on Cloudflare Pages and link your NOWPayments account to start accepting payments. Monitor your transactions closely as you process your first sale to ensure everything functions correctly. Use feedback from your initial customers to refine the user experience, addressing any issues they encounter during checkout or product delivery. This iterative process will help you build a reliable system that can handle increased traffic and sales in the future.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your initial launch, focus on scaling your operations. Leverage the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides six blueprints and seven templates to enhance your digital commerce stack. Consider diversifying your product offerings and marketing strategies to reach wider audiences in local and international markets. Utilize social media platforms and influencer partnerships to promote your ebooks and increase visibility. Continuously analyze your sales data to identify trends and adjust your strategies accordingly, ensuring growth and sustainability.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
With NOWPayments, you can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and other restricted markets searching for international payment solutions are looking for the same thing: a way to receive USD-equivalent payments from global buyers without a Stripe or PayPal account. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. For creators who want to self-deploy, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers both stack options with full source code and step-by-step configuration guides. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Register a domain for your digital store. Set up Cloudflare Pages for hosting your website. Integrate NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments. Store your digital products on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend processing. Test your payment and delivery pipeline before launching. Promote your ebooks through social media and other channels to attract buyers.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept payments in Kenya without Stripe?

To accept payments in Kenya without Stripe, use NOWPayments to process cryptocurrency transactions. This allows you to bypass traditional banking systems and enables you to receive payments in various cryptocurrencies directly.
What are the best payment options for selling ebooks in Nigeria?

In Nigeria, consider using NOWPayments for accepting cryptocurrency payments. This method eliminates the need for local banking solutions and allows you to receive payments quickly and efficiently through blockchain technology.
Can I sell digital products from Pakistan without PayPal?

Yes, you can sell digital products from Pakistan by using NOWPayments to process cryptocurrency payments. This alternative allows you to reach international buyers without relying on PayPal or other conventional payment platforms.
What are the advantages of using blockchain for payments?

Blockchain payments offer several advantages, including faster transaction speeds, lower fees, and enhanced security. Using cryptocurrencies eliminates the need for banks, giving you more control over your finances.
How do I ensure my digital products are delivered automatically?

To ensure automatic delivery of your digital products, set up a backend system using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. This system will manage order processing and send download links to customers upon payment confirmation.
Automated delivery ensures your customers receive products instantly.
